items.headline: Paul Pelosi in hit-and-run in California, car left with major damage, authorities say
items.summary: The husband of former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi was involved in a hit-and-run in California that left a parked car with "major" damage, authorities said Saturday.

items.headline: Nancy Pelosi’s husband could face hit-and-run charge after striking parked car
items.summary:
Paul Pelosi could face misdemeanor charges over crash in California that left car with ‘major’ damage, authorities say
